assertions.statement: The workbench renders 14, 30 and 90 day device timelines from server-authoritative occupied ranges.
Hundreds of devices are searchable and paginated by device lane rather than schedule row.
Pending and partially allocated order items expose server-selected candidates and use transactional assignment.
Device, order and logistics details open in right-side drawers without exposing unnecessary customer data.
A device remains occupied through outbound, customer possession, return transit and inspection completion.
